San Francisco Superior Court Case Search: A Comprehensive Guide

The San Francisco Superior Court is responsible for handling various types of civil and criminal cases. If you need to search for a case in this court, you can do so by using the online portal or visiting the courthouse in person. In this article, we will provide you with a step-by-step guide on how to search for a case in the San Francisco Superior Court, along with some essential information about the court system and its procedures.

Overview of the San Francisco Superior Court

The San Francisco Superior Court is a trial court of general jurisdiction. It has the authority to handle both civil and criminal cases, including misdemeanors, felonies, small claims, traffic infractions, and civil lawsuits. The court operates in four locations across San Francisco: Civic Center Courthouse, Hall of Justice, Juvenile Justice Center, and Traffic Court.

Types of Cases Handled by the San Francisco Superior Court

The San Francisco Superior Court handles various types of cases, including:

Civil Cases

Civil cases are disputes between two or more parties seeking monetary damages, specific performance of a contract, or injunctions. Examples of civil cases include breach of contract, personal injury, and property disputes.

Criminal Cases

Criminal cases involve offenses committed against the state, and the penalty for such offenses may include imprisonment, probation, fines, or community service. Examples of criminal cases include assault, battery, theft, and drug possession.

Small Claims

Small claims are civil cases in which the amount in dispute is $10,000 or less. These cases are generally resolved quickly and without the need for an attorney.

Traffic Infractions

Traffic infractions are violations of traffic laws, such as speeding, running a red light, or parking illegally. These cases are generally handled in traffic court.

How to Search for a Case in the San Francisco Superior Court

To search for a case in the San Francisco Superior Court, you can use the online portal or visit the courthouse in person.

Online Search

To search for a case online, follow these steps:

  1. Go to the San Francisco Superior Court website.
  2. Click on the "Online Services" tab.
  3. Click on the "Case Information" link.
  4. Enter the case number or the name of one of the parties involved in the case.
  5. Click on the "Search" button.
  6. The search results will display the case information, including the case number, the names of the parties involved, the case type, and the case status.

San Francisco Superior Court Criminal Case Search

If you are looking to search for criminal cases in the San Francisco Superior Court, you will need to visit the court's website and use their case search feature. This can be done by navigating to the "Case Search" tab on the homepage and selecting "Criminal Case" as the case type. From there, you can search for a case by the case number or the names of the parties involved in the case.

San Francisco Public Records Portal

The San Francisco Superior Court provides access to public records through its online portal. This portal allows you to search for court documents, calendars, and case information. To access the public records portal, navigate to the "Online Services" tab on the court's homepage and select "Public Access to Court Records."

San Francisco Superior Court Online

The San Francisco Superior Court provides several online services, including case search, eFiling, and online payment of fines and fees. To access these services, navigate to the "Online Services" tab on the court's homepage and select the service you need.

San Francisco Superior Court Local Rules

The San Francisco Superior Court has local rules that govern the conduct of cases filed in the court. These rules cover a wide range of topics, including civil and criminal procedure, court administration, and electronic filing. To access the court's local rules, navigate to the "Local Rules" tab on the court's homepage.

San Francisco Superior Court Department 610

Department 610 of the San Francisco Superior Court is responsible for handling criminal cases. It is located at the Hall of Justice and is presided over by Judge Tracie L. Brown. If you are looking for information about a criminal case, you may need to contact this department.
